Heisenberg introduced his now famous uncertainty relations in an article of 1927 , entitled “Ueber den anschaulichen Inhalt der quantentheoretischen Kinematik und Mechanik.” A (partial) translation of this title is: “The demonstrative content of quantum theoretical kinematics and mechanics.” .
